Logical.Description.Compare: Compares two scalar values exactly. Condition is a numeric 0/1 value; Event is a separate Signal emitted according to Mode.
Logical.Description.SignalAnd: Accepts one event on each input. Same Update requires both during one effect update; Accumulate Until Both keeps the first arrival across updates. Emits at most once per update.
Logical.Description.SignalOr: Emits one Signal when either input arrives, at most once per effect update. Pulse is a numeric 0/1 value for that update only.
Logical.Description.SignalToNumber: Converts incoming Signal events to a number as a same-update Pulse, a Latch held until Reset, or an exact event Counter cleared by Reset.
